name: Phase 10 Quad-Strategy Benchmark

metric_definitions.name: System Average Travel Time
metric_definitions.description: System-wide vehicle-weighted mean travel time across City A, City B, and the Intercity Corridor.

metric_definitions.name: System Average Queue Length
metric_definitions.description: Average number of spillover queued vehicles waiting at intersections and bottlenecks.

metric_definitions.name: System Combined Objective Cost
metric_definitions.description: Normalized multi-criteria system objective cost (travel time + congestion + queues + corridor + budget).

metric_definitions.name: City A Travel Time
metric_definitions.description: Mean trip duration within City A network.

metric_definitions.name: City A Congestion
metric_definitions.description: Average road congestion percentage within City A.

metric_definitions.name: City A Queue Length
metric_definitions.description: Sum of queued vehicles across City A roads.

metric_definitions.name: City B Travel Time
metric_definitions.description: Mean trip duration within City B network.

metric_definitions.name: City B Congestion
metric_definitions.description: Average road congestion percentage within City B.

metric_definitions.name: City B Queue Length
metric_definitions.description: Sum of queued vehicles across City B roads.

metric_definitions.name: Intercity Corridor Travel Time
metric_definitions.description: BPR-governed transit time along the shared intercity arterial connection.

metric_definitions.name: Intercity Corridor Queue
metric_definitions.description: Queued vehicles delayed at the intercity border gateway.

metric_definitions.name: Total Intervention Resource Cost
metric_definitions.description: Sum of operational policy deployment costs incurred across all simulation steps.

metric_definitions.name: Total Active Vehicles Served
metric_definitions.description: Total distinct traffic volume accommodated and processed by the system.

metric_definitions.name: Optimization Computation Time
metric_definitions.description: Wall-clock execution time for algorithmic decision optimization.

research_summary_text:
RESEARCH EVALUATION EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:

--- Scenario: NORMAL (N = 3 matched seeds) ---
• System Average Travel Time: Coordinated mean 7.2133 mins vs Independent 7.2133 mins (Improvement: -0.0%, 95% CI: [-0.0248, 0.0248], p=1.0000, Not Statistically Significant (p >= 0.05), Negligible effect (|dz| < 0.2))
• System Average Congestion: Coordinated mean 75.4967 % vs Independent 69.1333 % (Improvement: -9.21%, 95% CI: [-7.5496, -5.1771], p=0.0262, Statistically Significant (p < 0.05), Large effect size (|dz| >= 0.8))
• System Average Queue Length: Coordinated mean 45.39 vehicles vs Independent 51.6667 vehicles (Improvement: 10.87%, 95% CI: [-11.6359, 24.1892], p=1.0000, Not Statistically Significant (p >= 0.05), Large effect size (|dz| >= 0.8))

--- Scenario: PEAK (N = 3 matched seeds) ---
• System Average Travel Time: Coordinated mean 8.01 mins vs Independent 7.99 mins (Improvement: -0.25%, 95% CI: [-0.0857, 0.0457], p=0.4894, Not Statistically Significant (p >= 0.05), Medium effect size (0.5 <= |dz| < 0.8))
• System Average Congestion: Coordinated mean 93.3833 % vs Independent 89.2133 % (Improvement: -4.67%, 95% CI: [-4.9544, -3.3856], p=0.0196, Statistically Significant (p < 0.05), Large effect size (|dz| >= 0.8))
• System Average Queue Length: Coordinated mean 802.2467 vehicles vs Independent 743.3367 vehicles (Improvement: -8.04%, 95% CI: [-94.4123, -23.4077], p=0.1525, Not Statistically Significant (p >= 0.05), Large effect size (|dz| >= 0.8))

--- Scenario: BOTTLENECK (N = 3 matched seeds) ---
• System Average Travel Time: Coordinated mean 7.1033 mins vs Independent 6.9733 mins (Improvement: -1.86%, 95% CI: [-0.1548, -0.1052], p=0.0160, Statistically Significant (p < 0.05), Large effect size (|dz| >= 0.8))
• System Average Congestion: Coordinated mean 74.1567 % vs Independent 66.2367 % (Improvement: -11.96%, 95% CI: [-8.8551, -6.9849], p=0.0075, Statistically Significant (p < 0.05), Large effect size (|dz| >= 0.8))
• System Average Queue Length: Coordinated mean 2.9733 vehicles vs Independent 0.11 vehicles (Improvement: -1466.67%, 95% CI: [-7.1785, 1.4518], p=0.2075, Not Statistically Significant (p >= 0.05), Large effect size (|dz| >= 0.8))
academic_disclaimer: ACADEMIC & METHODOLOGICAL DISCLAIMER: All outcomes in this evaluation are derived from synthetic digital twin simulations (calibrated BPR travel-time curves, synthetic population diurnal demand). These outcomes represent simulation-based empirical evidence of algorithmic behavior under controlled conditions, and must not be interpreted as empirical proof of identical performance in real-world urban municipal infrastructure.
